intro.fallback: It is the time of the Third Shinobi World War.
Obito Uchiha is running late, for which his teammate, a young Kakashi Hatake, reprimands him when he eventually arrives.
Kakashi, having recently become a jōnin, is given gifts by his team-mates.

outro.fallback: As they travel through Kusagakure they discover they are being watched by an enemy ninja.
Kakashi decides to deal with the ninja with a new technique: the Chidori. pt-br:Capítulo 239: Primeira Parte: O Início da Missão...!!
